title: The identity directory merges two subjects
description: The identity directory merges two subject records while a call or pending work references one of them; authorization and context must be re-resolved against the surviving subject.
callerVisible: The caller is re-verified or told a person will follow up; no other person's data is disclosed.
backendEvidence: Grants re-checked against the surviving subject
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:SOURCE_MERGED] owned by WP-24 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the identity directory merges two subjects

postconditions: Context and grants are re-resolved before any disclosure
No record of the other subject is disclosed
